# Columns: traffic_omni_oa.dws_business_line_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live

## Column Usage Notes

### 非累加字段 (Non-Additive Fields)

`user_id` 跨维度聚合时须用 COUNT(DISTINCT)，不可直接 SUM：
- `COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN impr_cnt_1d > 0 THEN user_id END)` — 曝光用户数
- `COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN item_impr_cnt_1d > 0 THEN user_id END)` — item 曝光用户数

### 常见 WHERE 值 (Common Filter Values)

- `grass_region`: 亚洲各区 ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN') 及 'BR'
- `business_line = 'Homepage'` + `module = 'Daily Discover'` + `object = 'item card'` — 每日发现商品卡片
- `business_line = 'Homepage'` + `module NOT IN ('Daily Discover','Flash Sale')` — 首页其他模块
- `business_line = 'Homepage'` + `module NOT IN ('Daily Discover','Flash Sale','Shopee Live','Shopee Video')` — 排除直播视频后的首页其他
- `business_line = 'Search'` + `module = 'Global Search'` + `feature_detail LIKE '%-item'` — 全局搜索商品
- `business_line = 'Rcmd'` + `module = 'User Scenario'` + `object = 'you may also like'` + `feature_detail = 'product-you_may_also_like-item'` — YMAL 商品推荐
- `feature_detail = 'product-you_may_also_like-image_search_item'` — YMAL 导图片搜索
- `source1_feature_detail = 'product-you_may_also_like-livestream'` — YMAL 导直播
- `source1_feature_detail = 'product-you_may_also_like-search'` — YMAL 导搜索
- `business_line IS NULL` + `source1_business_line IS NULL` + `source2_business_line IS NULL` — 无法归因的流量
- `regional_date` 和 `local_date` 均作为日期分区过滤，不同任务使用不同列名
